استصرخن (form X)
# اِسْتَصْرَخْنَ (istaṣraḵna) /is.tasˤ.rax.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# اُسْتُصْرِخْنَ (ustuṣriḵna) /us.tusˤ.rix.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
# اِسْتَصْرِخْنَ (istaṣriḵna) /is.tasˤ.rix.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَصْرَخَ (istaṣraḵa)
